applicabilityBasis.summary: GGBR references 1/1000th of a troy ounce of gold and is advertised as redeemable against gold. Its reference unit is a commodity quantity rather than a fixed amount of monetary value in a national currency. The reviewed disclosures support commodity-token treatment under the GENIUS payment-stablecoin definition.

references.label: GENIUS Act: payment stablecoin definition tied to fixed monetary value
Goldfish support: each GGBR represents 1/1000th of a troy ounce

genius.notes: The official entity disclosure identifies GGBR, Ltd as the BVI token issuer and GGBR, Inc. as the U.S. manager. Goldfish publishes issuer collateral claims concerning in-situ gold held through the GGBR Trust. The redemption app publishes operative redemption terms: a 1,000 GGBR minimum, a 3% redemption fee, 5-7 business days of processing, vault storage or physical delivery, and KYC verification for physical gold redemption; the base profile records the minimum and fee as confirmed at Ethereum block 26236714 on 2026-10-20, so redemptionPolicyPresent is true for the reviewed public record. No independent monthly reserve-to-token-liability attestation series was found on the reviewed collateral/support pages. Smart-contract audits and geological/collateral claims are not reserve attestations. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization posture applies to the gold-denominated token. The OCC digital-assets list is a charter application list, not evidence of token-specific GENIUS approval.

references.label: OCC digital assets licensing applications: no GGBR, Ltd or Goldfish applicant identified in the visible pending-application table
